body.reason: Both design contracts SETTLED by counterparty verification. c-767fd5f7 (peer a): docs/hackathon-scope.md, docs/security-architecture.md, docs/trust-boundary.md, spec/schemas/secure-envelope.json - accepted on third submission (earlier rework was post-submit edits plus a missing 'trust boundary' phrase). c-f52fbdb9 (peer b): docs/hacp-secure-threat-model.md, docs/hacp-secure-modules.md, docs/hacp-secure-test-matrix.md (45 tests), docs/hacp-secure-non-goals.md - accepted first time. Architecture agreed after challenges 1-5 and F1-F7, all accepted: same-uid adversary with standard/degraded modes; two-tier contract binding with HOLD; signed-ephemeral X25519 and directional HKDF keys; seq-as-nonce; strict wire with require_secure pins (no TOFU); domain-separated signatures and no sign endpoint; memory-only replay state; bounded hold queue; SequenceGap on deletion; normative signature-before-AEAD pipeline with a routing check; TIER-2 as attributable claim with digest recomputation. REMAINING WORK: phase-2 implementation not started; proposed contracts P2-A..P2-D are in docs/hacp-secure-modules.md section 6 and need fresh bilateral agreement. Nothing is committed to git.
